sourceDelivery: Shared source archive contains exact aports recipes/patches/configs, this fixed acquisition map and upstream notices. 38 full upstream inputs were GET/SHA512 verified; their bytes are publicly obtainable at recorded official Alpine distfiles URLs and not duplicated inside this shared archive.

inTreeOnlyOrigins.alpine-base: Release/os-release content generated by retained APKBUILD; no external source input. Installed metadata says MIT.
inTreeOnlyOrigins.alpine-keys: Exact public key data and packaging are all retained; no external source input. Installed metadata says MIT.
inTreeOnlyOrigins.alpine-baselayout: Complete retained in-tree configuration/scripts plus exact SHA512-verified netbase6.4 protocols/services. Installed metadata says GPL-2.0-only. No separate upstream notice file invented.

noticeInterpretation: Full source and exact original notices retained/acquirable; certificate data MPL header and c_rehash MIT header included, build helper mk-ca-bundle curl header preserved without claiming helper is shipped. Package metadata license expressions retained unchanged. No legal certification.
